taskChanges.newValue: Verified userGetInfo.refillable IDs 6 (arena_battle) and 21 (grand_arena_battle) against captured response and splitlib/refillable.json. Dashboard reads today-only resource:refillable:6 and :21 independently, shows rank plus exact remaining battles, and leaves missing/stale counters unknown. The similarly numbered world-refillable:6 is Free Teleport and is intentionally excluded. npm run check passed 305 tests and built v0.9.87. System Decision Impact: none — this extends the existing observed-snapshot dashboard rule without changing its guidance.
